correctness.rationale: The planar shadow is a zonotope with exact perimeter 2 sum a_i||proj_S e_i||. Each squared edge projection length is Beta(1,(d−2)/2). Conditional Haar framing yields independent spherical radius/angular variables and E[ℓ_iℓ_j]=pi H_d/[2(d−1)] with H_d the explicitly normalized 3F2. Expanding the square gives coefficient 8/d on diagonals and 4pi H_d/(d−1) on pairwise products. Beta Taylor remainder and Stirling gamma ratio prove the unit cube variance limit 8−5pi/2. The d=3 formula is already known; the evaluated general correlation is the subject.
risks: The exact 3-cube perimeter second moment is prior known; the formula is for orthogonal-edge boxes, not all zonotopes.
